source.meaning: alpha-centroid transition deltas are a visual drift diagnostic; they are not anatomical root measurements or a quality score

observations: idle draft pivots keep the standing bodies on one ground line; small weapon/tail centroid motion remains
move draft keeps each frame on the state line while frame13 visibly retains an airborne gap
attack draft keeps a common registration line, while sword and torso changes create real pose motion
hit draft is visually compact around the line; no static crop jump was accepted as a pass
death frames stay on their per-frame visible-bottom line while the blade is included in that proxy; this is not anatomical foot contact

gates.nextReview: Use an in-context game scene to check body contact, facing, health bars and attack readability before considering an isolated runtime adapter.
